title: Kissed Juicy Uruguayan Strawberry Bake
description: A quick-fix Uruguayan dish featuring strawberries, with a hint of mustard and a wood-fired bake, perfect for a vegan-friendly dessert. This recipe combines the sweetness of strawberries with the tanginess of mustard.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the melted vegan butter, apple cider vinegar, Dijon mustard, and vanilla extract.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Gently fold in the sliced strawberries.
Pour the mixture into a 9x9 inch baking dish.
Bake for 35 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the fruit is tender.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve warm, garnished with additional sliced strawberries if desired.
